rdf:Description.skos:prefLabel: Refactor RML Execution Logic from map_rml.py
rdf:Description.skos:description: This ticket covers the refactoring of the RML execution logic from `map_rml.py`. The logic will be moved into a new `RMLMapper` class in `gbad_core/mapper.py`, which will be independent of the specific RML mapper implementation.
rdf:Description.skos:scopeNote:
**Relevant Code Snippets:** ```python def map_using_rmlmapper(rml, ttl): """Run the RMLMapper Java command.""" # ... java_command = [ "java", "-jar", rmlmapper, "-s", "turtle", "-m", rml, "-o", ttl, "-b", BASE_URI[:-1] ] # ...
def map_using_pyrml(rml, ttl): """Create an instance of RML Mapper with PyRML.""" raise NotImplementedError() ```
rdf:Description.skos:changeNote: **Implementation Plan:** 1. **Create `RMLMapper` Class in `gbad_core/mapper.py`:** - The `__init__` method will take a configuration object that specifies the mapper strategy (e.g., "rmlmapper-jar", "pyrml") and the path to the mapper executable if needed. 2. **Implement `map()` Method:** - This method will take the RML graph and the source DataFrame as input. - It will use a strategy pattern to call the appropriate private method for the configured mapper (e.g., `_map_with_jar`, `_map_with_pyrml`). 3. **Implement `_map_with_jar()` Method:** - This private method will contain the logic for executing the RMLMapper JAR file using `subprocess.run`. - It will need to write the source DataFrame to a temporary CSV file to be used by the JAR mapper.
